description: Single source of truth for the repo's sync/check rituals. Each row: id, generator cmd (null for check-only rituals), check cmd, fix hint, trigger path-globs (empty = always run in --changed mode), tier (pre-commit|preflight|both). Consumed by scripts/sync-all.sh; the pre-commit hook, CI, and preflight-portability delegate to sync-all so a new ritual is wired in ONE place. Trigger glob forms: entry ending '/' = directory prefix match; entry starting '*' = suffix match; otherwise exact path. Contract/tests: hooks/tests/sync-all.test.sh.
